# Uncertainty, Interpretability and Model Validation

> Produce the evidence an independent validator needs: calibrated probabilities, intervals with guarantees, honest explanations and a fit-for-use decision. SDAIA Academy course DS-305, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 22,095 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Can the probabilities be trusted](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/day1.md): Read the package as a validator, score its probabilities with proper scores, repair them and check the repair in every group; sessions: What a validator needs, Proper scores and reliability, Recalibration, Calibration by subgroup; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/day1.html; about 5,711 tokens
- [Day 2: Intervals with guarantees](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/day2.md): Wrap the loss model and the grade model in conformal intervals and prediction sets, then test the guarantee by group and under shift; sessions: Conformal intervals, Prediction sets, Coverage by group, Coverage under shift; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/day2.html; about 4,788 tokens
- [Day 3: What drives the predictions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/day3.md): Explain the default model three ways, test how stable each explanation is, and find where explanations mislead; sessions: Permutation importance, Effect plots, Shapley values, When explanations mislead; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/day3.html; about 4,958 tokens
- [Day 4: Validate and decide](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/day4.md): Turn the evidence into rated findings by subgroup, diagnose a decline, score the package against a checklist and decide; sessions: Subgroup validation, Diagnosing degradation, Checklists and model cards, The fit-for-use decision; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/day4.html; about 4,992 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: an independent validation](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/capstone.md): Eight-minute panel defence of a validation report, then four minutes of questions in which the panel picks one finding to rerun; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/slides/capstone.html; about 1,220 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Six claims, three verdicts](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D1_1_mark_six_model.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Scores and a reliability diagram](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D1_2_compute_brier_score.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Platt and isotonic on held-out rows](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D1_3_recalibrate_two_methods.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Calibration by region and age band](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D1_4_break_calibration_down.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Loss intervals with 90% coverage](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D2_1_wrap_loss_regression.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Sets for three risk grades](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D2_2_build_prediction_sets.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Coverage by group, then per group](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D2_3_measure_subgroup_coverage.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: An income shift, measured](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D2_4_simulate_income_shift.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Importance and its spread](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D3_1_compute_permutation_importance.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Partial dependence against local effects](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D3_2_show_where_partial.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Ten applicants, five refits](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D3_3_explain_ten_applicants.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A proxy takes the credit](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D3_4_show_how_correlated.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Gaps by group, tagged](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D4_1_tabulate_calibration_coverage.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: The cause of the decline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D4_2_find_seeded_cause.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: The package against a checklist](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D4_3_score_model_package.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: The decision and the capstone choice](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-305/labs/D4_4_draft_decision_conditions.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
